messages:
Alex K: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete owners/timelines for rollout guardrail work (auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, recurrence detection).
Maria P: Ill own auto-rollback policy. Will post a multi-signal draft + small canary traffic plan by Thu EOD.
Jon S: Assigning blast-radius controls to me: flag scoping, saturation caps, and deployment token buckets. ETA next Tue.
Irene C: Ill prototype recurrence detection (group by flag+model+error fingerprint). Target: demo in 2 sprints.
Taylor R: Can someone paste the postmortem link?
Alex K: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-22-service-degradation  see telemetry gaps section.
Maria P: Current rollback = 5xx >2% global. Proposal: require 2 independent signals in 10m window (p95 latency, user_error_rate, 5xx ramp) before auto-rollback. Also add a cooldown to avoid thrash.
Jon S: Blast-radius sketch: staged percents 1% -> 10% -> 100% with guard-timers and bucket cap = 5k users. Also add a per-flag token budget so CI/automation can't accidentally push to 100%.
Taylor R: Oncall needs a 1-page checklist: how to confirm metric validity, execute rollback, and smoke-test recovery. I can draft by Mon.
Maria P: Quick config prototype (pasted):
```
flag: new_vector_routing
stages:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 30m
    checks: [p95_latency, user_error_rate]
  - pct: 10
    duration: 3h
rollback_policy:
  require_signals: 2
  window: 10m
  cooldown: 15m
  notify: [eng-oncall, product-owner]
bucket:
  max_users: 5000
  token_rate: 100/min
```
Irene C: Recurrence rule example: same flag+model -> open remediation if >=3 incidents in 90d. Also wire to weekly reliability review. Ill add clustering to reduce noise.
Jon S: Note: infra review required for global quarantine switches and token bucket enforcement. Ill loop infra once spec is ready.
Taylor R: Suggest adding a fast synthetic probe on canary mirrors every 5m to catch regressions before user traffic. Maria, can you include that in the canary plan?
Maria P: Yeswill include synthetic probes and expected alert thresholds.
Alex K: Action summary (to track in follow-ups board):
- Auto-rollback multi-signal draft (owner: Maria P, due: Thu EOD)
- Canary test + synthetic probes (owners: Maria P + Jon S, due: next Tue)
- Blast-radius scoping + token caps (owner: Jon S, due: next Tue)
- Quarantine global switch spec (owner: Jon S, due: next Wed; infra review pending)
- Recurrence detection + auto-epic flow (owner: Irene C, due: sprint end)
- Oncall 1-page rollback checklist (owner: Taylor R, due: Mon)
Alex K: @safety-bot schedule follow-up sync in 7 days. Prioritize safety over velocity until these land.
safety-bot: Reminder set by Alex K: "Rollout guardrails follow-up" in 7 days.
